title: Input · Only the device in use
description: Every key in the HUD follows the device the player touched last: keyboard and mouse, or a pad by family (Xbox, PlayStation, Nintendo, generic). Faked pads in the page switch it; a key press switches it back.

steps.caption: Keyboard: WASD, E · Interactuar, Esc · Menú, R

steps.eval: window.fakePad = id => ({ id, index: 0, connected: true, mapping: 'standard', timestamp: 0, axes: [0, 0, 0, 0], buttons: Array.from({ length: 17 }, () => ({ pressed: false, value: 0 })) }); window.fakePads = [fakePad('Xbox Wireless Controller (Vendor: 045e)')]; navigator.getGamepads = () => window.fakePads;
